name: Hiren Soni
summary:
• Seasoned Salesforce Architect with over 15 years of expertise in designing and
implementing scalable, high-impact solutions. Currently serving as Manager – Salesforce
Architect at Full Potential Solution, spearheading the development of customized
platforms using Mobile Publisher, Experience Cloud, and Service Cloud to drive
business transformation.
• Provide strategic technical leadership, translating complex business challenges into
robust, scalable technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency and drive
superior business outcomes.
• Designing and implementing scalable, high-performance Salesforce solutions that
seamlessly integrate with enterprise systems, ensuring streamlined workflows and data
consistency across business functions.
• Expertise in Pre-Sales & Solution Consulting, driving business growth by developing
tailored proposals, conducting product demonstrations, and aligning solutions with
client needs to enhance sales effectiveness.
• Security, Compliance & Scalability – Architecting robust Salesforce environments with a
strong focus on security, compliance, and governance, optimizing system performance
while aligning with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
• Digital Transformation & Automation – Driving enterprise-wide digital transformation
by leveraging automation, data-driven insights, and user-centric design to enhance
operational efficiency, customer engagement, and business agility.
• Led the end-to-end RFI and RFP processes, gathering critical vendor insights, defining
requirements, assessing proposals, and negotiating contracts to drive informed decision-
making, optimal business solutions, and cost efficiency.
• Expert in strategic planning, technology solution architecture, automation, data
analytics, and continuous process improvement, ensuring business agility and sustained
innovation.
• Salesforce Certified Integration Architect and Data Architecture & Management
Designer, among multiple advanced certifications, reflecting a deep technical acumen
and expertise in enterprise architecture.
• Trusted advisor to leadership and stakeholders, ensuring technology aligns with
business objectives, maximizes ROI, and drives digital transformation at scale.
